nearest_cent.why: rounds VAT to the nearest cent (Decimal's default), so it can round up, which the chat ruled out

vat_20.why: lost Luxembourg's 17% and uses a typical 20% VAT

fee_at_50.why: boundary off by one: charges the fee at exactly 50.00 too (up to 50, not under 50)

fee_after_vat.why: adds the handling fee to the gross after VAT, not to the net before it
